ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure there is a rectangular piece of paper, and the dashed line connects from the lower-left corner to the upper-right corner, indicating folding along the diagonal of the rectangle. After folding, there are gray shaded parts extending outside the overlapping region, and these extending parts are cut off. From the figure it can be seen that after cutting, the retained region, when unfolded, will form a rhombus, of which one pair of opposite vertices are the lower-left corner and upper-right corner of the original rectangle, and another vertex is on the upper side of the rectangle. Reasoning: Mark the original rectangle as A, B, C, D according to the figure, where A is the lower-left corner, B is the lower-right corner, C is the upper-right corner, D is the upper-left corner, AB=12, AD=6, and the crease is diagonal AC. Let the vertex of the rhombus on the upper side DC be E, and let E=(x,6), that is, the horizontal distance from E to the left side is x. Since C=(12,6), EC=12-x. Also A=(0,0), so AE=sqrt(x^2+6^2)=sqrt(x^2+36). The unfolded figure is a rhombus, so adjacent sides AE and EC are equal: sqrt(x^2+36)=12-x. Squaring both sides gives x^2+36=(12-x)^2=144-24x+x^2, so 36=144-24x, 24x=108, x=4.5. Therefore the side length of the rhombus is EC=12-4.5=7.5. Final answer: 7.5

method.method_draft: Label the original rectangle as A bottom-left, B bottom-right, C top-right, D top-left, with AB=12 and AD=6, and the dashed fold diagonal AC as shown. From the cut pattern in the image, after unfolding the rhombus has opposite vertices A and C, one vertex E on the top edge DC, and the fourth vertex on the bottom edge by reflection. Let E=(x,6) measured from the left edge, so EC=12-x and AE=sqrt(x^2+6^2). Since the unfolded shape is a rhombus, adjacent sides AE and EC are equal: sqrt(x^2+36)=12-x. Squaring gives x=4.5, hence the side length is EC=12-4.5=7.5.

最终答案：7.5

method.method_draft: Work in the folded picture. Let A be the lower-left corner and C the upper-right corner; the dashed fold AC has slope 6/12=1/2, so if it makes angle theta with the horizontal then tan(theta)=1/2. The image shows the slanted exposed boundary from A to the top edge as the reflected image of the bottom edge after folding across AC. Reflection across a line rotates the direction symmetrically, so this boundary makes angle 2theta with the horizontal. Its slope is tan(2theta)=2(1/2)/(1-(1/2)^2)=4/3. Therefore, to rise 6 units to the top edge, it runs 6/(4/3)=4.5 units horizontally from the left side. The remaining top segment to the upper-right corner is 12-4.5=7.5, and this segment becomes a side of the unfolded rhombus.
